## Decisions made during build (spec was silent)
- 2026-11-19 WP2.4: `confirmation.confirmed` / `confirmation.cancelled` start a workflow **only when `order_outcome = APPLIED`** (the answer moved the order). An answer the order could not take (edited / no longer DRAFT) already alerts the seller, and booking or messaging on it would act on a guess (L11); a confirmation ended by the order's own cancel has no outcome and is `order.cancelled`'s job.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.4: `intake.draft_ready` has a new subject kind `draft` (provides only `draft`): no order or customer exists yet, so only `CONVERT_DRAFT_TO_ORDER` and the shop-level actions (notification, team task, webhook) fit; order/customer conditions are refused. A draft id not in the shop starts nothing.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.4: `REQUEST_CONFIRMATION` outcomes: SUCCEEDED with the policy's decision (`CALL` / `AUTO_CONFIRM` / `SELLER_REVIEW`) or `ALREADY_REQUESTED` on a repeat; SKIPPED `ORDER_NOT_DRAFT` / `CONFIRMATION_ENGINE_DISABLED` (flag re-checked at run time). Enabling a workflow with the step while the flag is off is a blocker like `COURIER_NOT_CONNECTED` (recipe install → draft). No extra publish permission: `automation.manage` (owner, manager) already implies `order.write`.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.4: `CONVERT_DRAFT_TO_ORDER` may be published and enabled (literal spec: it *returns* `SKIPPED/AUTOPILOT_DISABLED`); every run records the skip, so the seller sees why nothing converted. Phase 4 replaces the body with the Autopilot gate.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.4: the recipe the spec calls "Confirmed → book courier → tracking SMS" is named **"Customer confirmed → book courier → send tracking"**: `SEND_TEMPLATE` has no SMS channel (EMAIL / WHATSAPP only), so promising an SMS would claim an unsupported capability. Keys `order_confirm_customer`, `confirmation_book_track`. A shop with both this and the V3.4 `order.confirmed → book` workflow books once (second step `ALREADY_BOOKED`, tested).
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: **who may dial** = the spec's `order.write` (owner, manager, order operator). `call_now` is the first path where non-owners get a full number (reveal is `customer.export`, owner-only), so it answers only for an order in the queue, honours quiet hours, writes `privacy.phone_revealed` (`confirmation_call`) + `confirmation.call_started` per call and allows 30 calls per user per 10 minutes (operator action to confirm).
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: the seller's call has no state of its own: a `MANUAL_CALL` attempt (`STARTED` → `CONFIRMED` / `CANCELLED` / `NO_ANSWER`). A `CALL_QUEUED` row the seller acts on goes `→ SELLER_REVIEW` (`VOICE_UNAVAILABLE`) first, with no seller alert (`_finish` skips `review_needed` for that cause when a seller is the actor). `mark_*` method = `MANUAL_CALL` when an open manual attempt exists, else `SELLER`. "Dhoreni" keeps the row in review and emits no `confirmation.no_answer` (that topic is the state machine's `NO_ANSWER`). Manual calls count in `attempt_count`; **WP3.2 must decide whether they count toward `MAX_CALL_ATTEMPTS`.** Dialing again before an answer reuses the open attempt.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: the SMS link follows only the table's `NO_ANSWER → SMS_LINK_SENT` (after the last unanswered call); a manual "Dhoreni" sends none (no `SELLER_REVIEW → SMS_LINK_SENT` move). In Phase 2 nothing reaches `NO_ANSWER`, so links start with Phase 3's IVR unless the operator adds that move.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: SMS text uses **"Tk", not "৳"**: the taka sign is outside GSM 03.38 and would make the message UCS-2 (70 chars/segment, ~2 segments), against the spec's single-GSM-segment target. Shop name cut to 24 characters; a Bangla shop name still makes it UCS-2 (segments recorded on the attempt: provider-reported, else the GSM/UCS-2 count; new column `confirmation_attempts.segments`).
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: token = first 16 bytes of HMAC(session-derived key, `conflink.v1|<link id>`), base64url = 22 chars; only SHA-256 stored. Derived rather than random so the outbox handler (`confirmation.link_requested`) can send and a retried send carries the same link (SMS idempotency key `conflink:<link id>`). The sweep creates link + attempt and moves the row in one transaction; the handler sends. Refused / not configured / no customer → link expired and `LINK_EXPIRED → SELLER_REVIEW`; a temporary failure raises so the outbox retries.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: `follow_up_confirmations` (every 5 min) also does `NO_ANSWER → CALL_QUEUED` (`RETRY`) after 30 min while calls are left, for Phase 3 to reuse; after the last call the link is due at once. Quiet hours hold the SMS (the row stays `NO_ANSWER`); the retry call is not quiet-checked here (Phase 3's dialer must be).
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: public routes always answer `200` with one shape (`status` OPEN / ANSWERED / UNAVAILABLE, then nulls); an unknown token reads exactly like an expired or closed one; a used link shows only shop name + result. A POST on an expired link changes nothing (the sweep moves the row). Limits per client address hash: 60 views and 10 answers per minute. `Cache-Control: no-store`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, page `noindex` + `referrer: no-referrer`.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: the web page calls the API through the existing `request` with a new `anonymous` option (no token, a 401 signs nobody out) instead of a second `fetch`, so `tests/parity.test.mjs` is unchanged. Bangla first with an English toggle (the reader is the customer).
- 2026-11-19 WP2.3: mobile entry = an orders-list banner "N orders waiting for a call" (hidden when empty, switched off or unreachable). Tapping a row (not Call) opens the outcome sheet, for a call made outside the app. `url_launcher` `tel:` only; no new permission.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: **one open confirmation per order** = a partial unique index with both `postgresql_where` and `sqlite_where` (SQLite supports partial indexes, so ADR 0004's "PostgreSQL-only feature" guard does not apply); tested on SQLite.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: the state machine is a `(from, to) → allowed causes` table; each terminal cause fixes `method` (IVR for DTMF, SMS_LINK for the link, AUTO_TRUSTED for the policy; seller causes take SELLER / MANUAL_CALL / SELLER_CHAT only). The order ending a confirmation (edit, cancel) records no method.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: a non-material edit (address, note, small COD change) does **not** refresh the snapshot: a later yes is recorded with `order_outcome = ORDER_CHANGED` and the seller is alerted (literal spec: the order moves only at `order_version`). A customer **no** is applied under the same guard (DRAFT + same version), not only the yes.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: "Already confirmed in chat" creates the row already `CONFIRMED` (method + reason `SELLER_CHAT`, the seller as actor) rather than walking `PENDING → CONFIRMED`, which the spec reserves for `AUTO_TRUSTED`.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: a seller cancel from review cancels the order with `CUSTOMER_DECLINED` when the method is MANUAL_CALL / SELLER_CHAT (the customer said no), else `CONFIRMATION_CANCELLED_BY_SELLER`.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: `request` is idempotent per order: it returns the open row, or the latest finished one (no second confirmation after one ended; only a material edit restarts). `SELLER_CHAT` while one is open → `CONFIRMATION_IN_PROGRESS` on the API; through an order create it returns the open row.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: the seller confirming the order directly while a confirmation is open leaves it open (the spec lists no such move); a later customer answer is recorded `ORDER_NOT_DRAFT`. **WP3.2's call dispatcher must skip orders that left DRAFT.**
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: the sheet's buttons send an optional `confirmation` mode (`REQUEST` | `SELLER_CHAT`) **with** the order create — `POST /v1/orders`, `/chat-orders/{id}/confirm` and the offline ORDER create in `/v1/sync/mutations` — so order and confirmation are one transaction and one queued mutation (no new offline entity type). Ignored while the flag is off (a replayed create must land); order sources (website/store) are refused the field.
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: one notification kind `CONFIRMATION_NEEDS_ATTENTION` with a `reason` (REVIEW_NEEDED / ORDER_CHANGED / ORDER_NOT_DRAFT), raised by the outbox handlers in a tenant-scoped session, deduped per confirmation + reason, entity = the order. No customer details in the text (lock screen).
- 2026-11-19 WP2.1: constants from later WPs are fixed in `app/confirmations/service.py`: `MAX_CALL_ATTEMPTS = 2`, `RETRY_AFTER = 30 min` (enforced on RETRY), `LINK_TTL = 6 h` (sets `next_action_at` on SMS_LINK_SENT).
